verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API (OpenAPI 3.1), an MCP server, and general 'API integrations', but nothing shows registrable outbound webhooks or Zapier triggers for new-mail or scan-complete events. Generic claims about API-based syncing are not event callbacks, and a pull-style REST API would still require polling.

support.subject: As a developer, I get webhooks (or at least Zapier triggers) when new mail arrives or a scan completes, so downstream automation starts without polling
